description: One user's vote on which work an edition belongs to. Bibliograph applies the link to the catalog only when enough votes agree (see EDITION_WORK_CONSENSUS_THRESHOLD). The rkey is the edition's rkey, so each account holds at most one vote per edition; changing your mind updates the existing record.

edition.description: The catalog edition this vote is about.

work.description: The work this edition should belong to. Required when action is 'link', omitted when action is 'unlink'.

action.description: Whether the edition should be linked to `work`, or have its current work link removed.
